exposure: SWC status (receipt of a postpartum six-week check)
severity of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 30,483 women aged 15-49 years at childbirth between 2000-2018 in the UK, who were diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and registered for at least 12 months postpartum.
finding: Of women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, 61.4% received a postpartum six-week check (SWC), with decreasing prevalence after 2007 and significant disparities in provision based on sociodemographic and clinical factors; women who received a SWC had higher rates of blood pressure recording and postpartum depression diagnosis.
mod_finding: Women were less likely to have a six-week postpartum check record if they had a caesarean birth.
